title: Cervical Cancer Screening: Age-Banded Windows
description: Build CMS124's shape — the cervical cancer screening measure. Women 23-64 with a visit form the Initial Population; screening counts via a 3-year cytology window OR a 5-year HPV window; hysterectomy and hospice exclude. Simplified to single representative codes (LOINC 10524-7 cytology, LOINC 21440-3 HPV DNA, SNOMED 116140006 total hysterectomy) — production measures expand these to full VSAC value sets.
learningObjectives: Define the measurement period plus 3-year cytology and 5-year HPV lookback intervals
Build the Initial Population from gender, an age window, and a visit during the period
Match screening observations by LOINC code AND system
Apply two Denominator Exclusions: hysterectomy and hospice
Compose the Numerator from two alternative screening windows (or)
Read population membership across an 8-patient cohort with every branch represented

hints.message: Interval[@2022-01-01, @2024-12-31] — the measurement period or the two years prior, i.e. a 3-year window.
Interval[@2020-01-01, @2024-12-31] — the measurement period or the four years prior, i.e. a 5-year window.
Patient.gender = 'female' — direct element access on the Patient context resource.
"Is Female" and "Age At Start" between 23 and 64 and "Had Office Visit" — three criteria and-ed together.
exists([Procedure] P where exists(P.code.coding cod where cod.code = '116140006' and cod.system = 'http://snomed.info/sct')) — SNOMED total hysterectomy.
"Denominator" and ("Had Hysterectomy" or "In Hospice") — two exclusion paths, parenthesized.

exists([Observation] O where exists(O.code.coding cod where cod.code = '10524-7' and cod.system = 'http://loinc.org') and (O.effective as FHIR.dateTime) during "Cytology Lookback") — remember the choice-type cast.
Same shape with LOINC 21440-3 against "HPV Lookback" — Faye's 2019 HPV test falls outside this window.
"Denominator" and not "Denominator Exclusion" and ("Had Recent Cytology" or "Had Recent HPV") — either screening window qualifies.
